Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money, though you still need to manually execute external payments. Gives you a little extra interest on money allocated for taxes too.

On Trustpilot, Relay has received 776 reviews and has a 4.2/5 rating. Users appreciate the ability to open many accounts, their helpful customer support, and user-friendly interface. But some customers have encountered minor issues, such as issues with permissions, glitches with account money transfers, and problems with prescribed limits.

Relay's basic plan is entirely free, at $0/month... if your business needs faster, same-day ACH and more advanced billing features, then the Relay Pro plan will set you back $30 per business/month. You can have up to 20 individual checking accounts without any monthly fees on either plan.
For Relay's physical cards, there is a maximum daily card transaction limit of $7,000 and an ATM withdrawal limit of $1,000 per card.

Relay's international transfer system is incredibly easy to use. Pricing is straightforward - although not exactly affordable at $10 per outgoing transaction. If you're on the Relay Pro plan, the fee is waived.
